features.title: Power through mystery
features.text: Your mystery shapes divine spellcasting and grants revelation focus spells. You also gain cursebound abilities that draw power at a personal cost.

features.title: Choose when to push
features.text: Cursebound abilities advance your curse; revelation spells do not do so merely for being focus spells. Refocusing eases the curse. Weigh each extra benefit against its drawbacks.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2.5 → 3–4.5. Mystery spells, revelation spells and offensive selections support stronger damage than the old flat score suggested.
ratings.defense: 2 → 2.5–3.5. Eight HP and light armor help; mystery and spell choices can improve survival.
ratings.support: 5 → 3.5–5. Divine spells and cursebound abilities support healing and party aid, depending on selections.
ratings.utility: 4 → 3–4. Divine magic plus mystery-granted spells offers useful but variable exploration tools.
ratings.difficulty: 4 → 3.5. Track cursebound abilities separately from focus spells; only the former advance the curse.
